card.name: Inside the word iodine
card.fires_on: The pieces of the word iodine (Iod, iod, ine, IOD) in drug labels, mostly the start or end of iodine, iodinated or iodism. It also fires on a few other word endings such as INJECTION and the state abbreviation IA.

modes.label: Iodine word pieces
modes.description: The first or last piece of iodine, iodinated or iodism in thyroid and contrast-agent text.

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: Rare hits on the end of INJECTION in a drug title or on a state abbreviation in an address.
